            "text": "---",

          },
          {
            "text": "import { getCollection, render } from \"astro:content\";",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },

            "text": "import type { GetStaticPaths, InferGetStaticPropsType } from \"astro\";",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "import Article from \"../../layouts/Article.astro\";",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "export const getStaticPaths = (async () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "  const FIX_HUBS = [\"electrical\", \"engine\", \"brakes\", \"ac-heating\", \"suspension\", \"noises-smells\", \"exhaust\", \"transmission\"];",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  const articles = await getCollection(\"articles\", ({ data }) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    const inFixHub = data.hubs.some((h: string) =&gt; FIX_HUBS.includes(h));",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    const isTroubleshooting = data.articleType === \"troubleshooting\";",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "    return (inFixHub || isTroubleshooting) &amp;&amp; !data.draft;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  });",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  return articles.map((entry) =&gt; ({",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    params: { slug: entry.id.replace(/\\.mdx?$/, '') },",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    props: { entry },",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  }));",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "}) satisfies GetStaticPaths;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "type Props = InferGetStaticPropsType&lt;typeof getStaticPaths&gt;;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "const { entry } = Astro.props as Props;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "const { Content } = await render(entry);",

            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "const articles = await getCollection(\"articles\", ({ data }) =&gt; {",

          {

          },

          {
            "text": "const sortedArticles = articles.sort((a, b) =&gt; {",

          },
          {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# The Driveway Mechanic",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Fix it yourself. Save hundreds.**",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "A comprehensive automotive DIY and maintenance website built with Astro + MDX, designed to help everyday drivers handle basic car maintenance and repairs in their driveway.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚗 What We Cover",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Fix &amp; Troubleshoot**: Symptom-first diagnosis and repair guides",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Maintain &amp; Prevent**: DIY maintenance schedules and how-tos",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Buy &amp; Compare**: Parts and tools buyer guides with affiliate recommendations",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
